bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 170, Number 127 (Friday, August 2, 2024)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Ms. TOKUDA:
H.R. 9300.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8, Clauses 1 and 18 of the United States
Constitution.
The single subject of this legislation is:
To amend title II of the Social Security Act and the
Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to make improvements in the
old-age, survivors, and disability insurance program.
[Page H4975]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Social Security.
